system.description: Nearby ware and devices begin to mimic whatever you are currently doing: lenses refocus with your eyes, manipulators twitch with your hands, lights flicker in your rhythm. For WIL ÷ 5 minutes, opponents within Close range suffer -10 on any test the disturbance could plausibly interfere with, -10 more per superior success. Cyberbrains and life-support systems are never affected.
